title: Trump, Zelenskyy Discuss Peace Negotiations, Potential Energy Cease-Fire
content: US President Donald Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Trump said he believes that both sides "want to see the war end." Zelenskyy said Ukraine is pushing for an agreement with Russia on halting attacks on energy infrastructure.

title: Can Belarus Replace Canada As US Potash Provider?
content: US President Donald Trump has said a “massive deal” is being discussed with Belarus, under which it would provide cheaper potash supplies than Canada. But questions since the announcement have swirled over whether Belarus can replace the world's largest potash producer to meet US needs.

title: Butcher Of Bucha: Ballistics Tie Russian Sniper To Killings Of Ukrainian Civilians
content: An RFE/RL investigation links Russian sniper Artem Dementyev to killings and shootings of civilians during the 2022 occupation of Bucha. Ukrainian investigators say ballistic evidence, surveillance footage, and witness testimony point to his involvement in at least five killings and torture.

title: Former RFE/RL Journalist Reza Valizadeh Marks Two Years In Iranian Prison

title: EU Reportedly Set To Remove Sanctions On Russian Oligarchs Fridman And Usmanov

title: Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground

title: Kyrgyz Families Plead For Return Of Islamic State Fighters' Wives, Relatives From Iraqi Prisons
